boxes.en: The Holiness of the Partridge Jataka Tale 2 of Seniority and Respect
In the past, on the slopes of the Himalayas, lived three friends—an elephant, monkey, and an ordinary partridge. Yet, they lacked respect and order, living together without subordination.
Realizing this chaos was unseemly, they decided to discover who among them was the senior, so they could honor him. To measure their ages, they looked to the great banyan tree.
